exported_via: BigQuery console, Save results as CSV (local file)

metric_definitions.function_call_actions: Number of rows in receipt_actions with action_kind = FUNCTION_CALL for that block_date. One transaction can produce several actions, so this is NOT a transaction count.
metric_definitions.distinct_contracts: Number of distinct receipt_receiver_account_id values with at least one FUNCTION_CALL action that day. This is NOT a complete measure of active contracts.
metric_definitions.top5_calls: Function-call actions received by the 5 most-called receiver accounts that day.

known_observations: 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-15 had 7455968, 12700267 and 11615182 function-call actions, against a snapshot median of 1482979. The top 5 receiver accounts held 69.5%, 87.4% and 91.4% of actions on those days (snapshot median share: 47.2%). Distinct contracts on those days (1477, 1524, 1476) did not rise. Cause not verified.
Distinct receiver contracts were between 832 and 921 per day from 2026-08-06 to 2026-08-13, and between 1137 and 1523 per day from 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-31. The reason for the rise is not verified.
